title: Implement Photo identity persistence

gates.name: Python typecheck
gates.command: docker compose run --rm --no-deps backend python -m mypy src/face_moment

gates.name: Photo persistence tests
gates.command: docker compose run --rm backend python -m pytest tests/inventory/test_photo_persistence.py

evidence_required: .memory-bank/domains/photo-admission.md#face_momentphotos RED: no inventory-owned Photo persistence shape exists; GREEN: migration and repository metadata expose every required field, authoritative date/time sources, private original reference and the exact same-scope SHA-256 uniqueness constraint without a public create command; decisive comparison: schema introspection and repository contract match the canonical table; artifact: migration and repository test output.
purpose: Create the inventory-owned Photo identity and constraint substrate required by later atomic admission without prematurely exposing an admission command.
success_outcome: The shared schema contains the complete inventory-owned Photo persistence shape and exact logical uniqueness constraint, with ownership-safe references and no partial public admission path.
anti_goals: Do not publish Photo rows through an API or implement pending-state creation, duplicate outcome handling, object staging or crash recovery.
Do not add Batch, manifest, confirmation, purge or processing-transition fields.

forbidden_scope: Public Photo admission commands or endpoints
Inventory deletion, purge and later processing/search behavior
stop_conditions: The accepted Photo identity, ownership or uniqueness key would need to change.
The migration would require a cross-owner delete cascade.
The task would expose a Photo without the later atomic pending-state boundary.

constraints: inventory owns Photo models/repositories under src/face_moment/inventory/.
The exact uniqueness key is spa_id, visit_date and checksum_sha256.
uploader_id is an immutable audit reference; no cross-capability foreign key is required.
invariants: visit_date is authoritative and captured_at has an explicit source.
The table contains no Batch, confirmation or per-photo purge state.
No database cascade crosses from inventory into processing, Promo or diagnostics ownership.
verification_targets: Migration ancestry, upgrade, downgrade, re-upgrade, schema introspection and repository-shape proof run in isolated PostgreSQL state.
